name: Cua long
summary: Cua lông is a hairy crab from the former Hải Dương land now inside the city. It is not the crab in bánh đa cua.
origin: The former Hải Dương land now inside Hai Phong, on the city portal’s 16 October 2025 account.
where: The former Hải Dương side. No port street was named. Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Cua long — a former Hai Duong dish now in Hai Phong
seoDescription: A hairy crab from the former Hải Dương land now inside the city, not the crab in bánh đa cua.
